recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no source follow-up is needed unless future diagram generation reintroduces lower-case fragments.
issue_request: FHIR-13746 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction asking to fix dead links from the Complex data types diagram to Quantity-derived datatypes; the resolution identified it as a capitalization issue and auto-approved the fix.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to svn revision 12450. The matching git-svn commit 82431f7b7135396ed246c8f731c393a974be4d4a changed SvgGenerator.java to emit datatype href fragments with the original datatype name casing instead of lower-casing them.
additional_context: FHIR-13401 was applied by the same revision for the same datatype diagram link-casing problem. The current datatypes page and diagram inputs are in build scope through source/datatypes.html and active source/fhir.ini [diagrams] entries. Current diagram class names and datatypes anchors match with uppercase Quantity-specialization names, checked-in SVG hrefs do not contain lower-case Quantity-specialization fragments, and the current build.fhir.org datatypes page did not show the old lower-case fragments.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the historical fix and current source/build surfaces show the reported dead links are already corrected.

related_jiras.note: Same svn revision 12450 and git commit fixed the broader wrong-case datatype diagram links for Count, Money, SimpleQuantity, and related entries.
